## Why we're leaving

- No multi-party visits, so interpreters and caregivers need separate calls.
- Android drop-off rates roughly double iOS.
- No screen sharing.

## Exit plan

1. Pilot clinics move off Larkspur in January 2027; all clinics by early March 2027.
2. Larkspur returns visit metadata exports by April 15, 2027 and certifies destruction of remaining data by April 30, 2027.
3. Virtual Care removes Larkspur from the systems inventory after destruction is certified.

## Notes

- Do not sign any new Larkspur order forms. Requests for more Larkspur licenses go to Dana Okafor.
- Larkspur's support line remains available during the extension.
